mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_chunk_tag_job( job_uid, report_id, chunk_uid, dictionary_version, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{jobUid}, #{reportId}, #{chunkUid}, #{dictionaryVersion}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{lastError}, #{nextRunAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_uid, report_id, chunk_uid, dictionary_version, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM report_chunk_tag_job WHERE chunk_uid = #{chunkUid} AND dictionary_version = #{dictionaryVersion}

SELECT id, job_uid, report_id, chunk_uid, dictionary_version, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM report_chunk_tag_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND attempt_count < max_attempts ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE report_chunk_tag_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE report_chunk_tag_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE report_chunk_tag_job SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
